verdict.rationale: DBOS is a durable-workflow library with a Conductor console, which could plausibly include a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside the product. The MCP server only lets an external LLM or agent manage DBOS workflows. The AI docs (agent quickstart, OpenAI Agents and Vercel integrations, HITL) are building blocks for developers' own agents, not an in-product assistant users can delegate to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
